summary: Reviewed origin/master..e2e5b21 (db966bb, e2e5b21). Intended: publish per-agent live Run identity/age/cancel in status from owner records written at Runner dispatch and removed on completion; reconcile stale records at scheduler startup; surface live_run_error when records are unreadable. build/vet/test/secrets all exit 0. Traced Runner.Run write/remove lifecycle (deferred os.Remove safe: inFlight clears after run returns), scheduler startup cleanup under exclusive Kernel lock with fenced Serve drain, and forest run cancel path for the published run-id; tests cover JSON and human output, elapsed clamp, error visibility, and stale-record cleanup. Minor non-blocking notes: status can transiently publish live_run_error if a record is removed between ReadDir and ReadFile during completion; a crash inside writeLiveRun can leave a live-*.json.tmp residue cleanup does not remove; unusual agent names can slug-collide. No blocking finding.
